description: Implementation of ShippingService interface handling shipping configurations, quotes, modules, and calculations for an e-commerce platform.

classes.name: ShippingServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing shipping logic, configuration management, and quote calculation for an e-commerce platform.

methods.name: getShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves shipping configuration for a merchant store, parsing JSON stored in merchant configuration.

methods.name: getShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves specific shipping module configuration by module code for a merchant store.

methods.name: getCustomShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves custom configuration for a specific shipping module.

methods.name: saveShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Saves shipping configuration for a merchant store as JSON.

methods.name: saveCustomShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Saves custom configuration for a shipping module.

methods.name: getShippingMethods
methods.description: Returns list of available shipping modules for a store based on region.

methods.name: saveShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates and saves shipping quote module configuration.

methods.name: getShippingModulesConfigured
methods.description: Returns all configured shipping modules for a store.

methods.name: getShippingSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary object for shipping quote details.

methods.name: getShippingQuote
methods.description: Calculates shipping quote based on delivery, products, and store settings.

methods.name: getSupportedCountries
methods.description: Returns list of country codes supported for shipping.

methods.name: getShipToCountryList
methods.description: Returns list of countries available for shipping based on configuration.

methods.name: setSupportedCountries
methods.description: Stores list of supported country codes in merchant configuration.

methods.name: getPackagesDetails
methods.description: Returns package details for products based on configuration.

methods.name: requiresShipping
methods.description: Determines if any cart items require shipping.
